title: Product configurator: native option groups driving a damped orbit, tweened materials and a shareable URL
summary: A lamp built in code (a lathe foot, a brass stem, a cord and a 28-point lathe shade whose cone and drum are morph targets of the dome) on a clamped orbit, azimuth `−50°…50°` and polar `1.1…1.5` rad damped by `1 − .002^dt`, turned by drag or by arrow keys on a focusable `role="slider"` view with a reset; colour (five swatches), finish (matte / satin / gloss as roughness, clearcoat, its roughness and environment intensity) and shade are native radio groups whose every change tweens the live `MeshPhysicalMaterial` or morph weights from the current value (`.4 s`, `overwrite: true`), sets the `Intl` GBP price, the spec line and an `aria-live="polite"` summary in the same task, and writes `?colour=…&finish=…&shade=…` with `replaceState`, restored on load; a GSAP ticker listener draws only while the view damps or a tween runs; Neutral tone mapping and a built `RoomEnvironment` keep the swatch colour; reduced motion sets every choice at once with no arrival turn, and the static tier, `?nogl` or no WebGL2 hand the same controls to a CSS-drawn lamp
variants: lamp: colour, finish and a morphed shade (this)
a part swap instead of a morph: separate meshes toggled by visible, for options whose shapes do not share a vertex count
with a bag: the add-to-bag answer and a drawer from cart-drawer-quick-add
photographed variants: the same form and URL driving an image set when there is no model
